text:
Type: deep-seat three-seat sofa
Use: seating, lounging; living room
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: polyester woven fabric, dark feet
Colors: warm greige, taupe
Shape: wide track arms, two deep seat cushions, plump back cushions and throw pillows, hidden low feet, bulky and low
